user.title: Integration Watchdog
user.description: Reloads the integrations whose entities are all unavailable.

data_description.grace_period: Minutes every entity of an integration must have been unavailable before it is reloaded. Nothing is reloaded during this time after Home Assistant has started.
data_description.max_reloads: Reloads of an integration that stays unavailable before giving up on it until it recovers. The delay between two reloads doubles each time: grace period, 2 × grace period…
data_description.ignored_integrations: Integrations never reloaded. Type a domain to add one that isn't set up yet.
data_description.notify_services: Also send each notification with these actions (notify.mobile_app_…). A persistent notification is always created.

check.name: Check integrations
check.description: Looks for the integrations whose entities are all unavailable and reloads those past the grace period.

common.reloaded: {title} ({domain}) was reloaded: all its entities were unavailable since {since}. Reload {attempt}/{max}.
common.reload_failed: {title} ({domain}) could not be reloaded: all its entities were unavailable since {since}. Reload {attempt}/{max}, see the logs.
common.gave_up: {title} ({domain}) is still unavailable after {max} reloads. It won't be reloaded again until one of its entities is available.
